structures.name: 1-bromo-3-(bromomethyl)-2-chloro-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzene

drawings.notes: Labelled [图 8] (Figure 8). The figure is a 13C NMR spectrum with the structure drawn as an inset at the top left. Abscissa is labelled 'f1 (ppm)' running from about 160 on the left to about 20 on the right in steps of 10; the tick numerals are heavily broken up by the scan and were read from spacing as much as from the glyphs. Signals: a cluster of five lines in the aromatic region (roughly 140 down to 128, two of them tall), a tall line near the solvent region around 77, and two further tall lines to its right (roughly 45 and 25). No numeric peak labels, integrals or coupling data are printed on the figure, so no shift value on this page is transcribed from printed text. Ring numbering above takes the sulfonyl-bearing carbon as C1 and records only the drawn positions relative to one another.

structures.name: 1-bromo-2-chloro-4-(methanesulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzene

drawings.notes: Labelled [图 9] (Figure 9). The same ring as [图 8] but with the benzylic bromide replaced by a 2,2,2-trifluoroethyl ether, drawn as an inset above a 1H NMR spectrum. The terminal label was checked at high magnification and reads CF3 (C, F, subscript 3), with a single drawn O in the middle of the side chain. Abscissa is labelled 'f1 (ppm)' running from about 8.5 on the left to about 1.5 on the right in 0.5 steps; tick numerals are degraded and read only approximately. Signals: two tall close aromatic lines near 8.0-7.9, a tall line near 5.0, a line near 4.3 with a shoulder, a very tall line near 3.1 and a shorter line near 2.4. No numeric peak labels are printed on the figure.

illegible: All x-axis tick numerals on both spectra are pixelated and only approximately readable; the ranges given (160 to 20 in steps of 10 for [图 8]; 8.5 to 1.5 in 0.5 steps for [图 9]) were reconstructed from tick spacing plus partial glyphs, not read cleanly digit by digit.
The axis titles beneath both plots are degraded; they are read as 'f1 (ppm)' from shape and position rather than character by character.
Peak positions quoted in the drawing notes are estimated by eye against the tick marks; no peak-picked numerals are printed anywhere on this page.
